verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships a genuine profiler-like tool — the Scene Inspector for runtime debugging/scene analysis (docs-13, docs-20, docs-29) — and community confirms a real WebGL debugger (Spector.js, comm-10) plus general 'optimization' docs (docs-4). However there's no evidence of data-oriented scaling primitives like an ECS, a job/worker system, or instancing support, and community notes raise concerns about heavy object allocation/GC pressure (comm-13) that could hurt heavy-scene performance. missing for 10: ECS architecture docs, job/parallelism system, explicit instancing guidance, and independent benchmarks validating the profiler at scale.
